messages.content: Hey there! Since I'm currently residing in Rivermist but planning a grand getaway to Los Angeles, I'm curious about the price of a business class flight for December 15th, 2026. What's the current rate you can find?

I'd be happy to help you check flight prices from Rivermist to Los Angeles for December 15th, 2026! However, I currently don't have access to real-time flight pricing information through my available tools.

To get accurate business class flight rates for your specific travel date, you would need to:

1. Check directly with airlines that service both locations
2. Use a flight comparison website or app
3. Contact a travel agent who can provide current pricing

What I can help you with instead is:
- Finding the nearest airport to Rivermist
- Getting information about airports in Los Angeles
- Helping you book a flight once you have the pricing information

Would you like me to assist with any of these alternative options, or would you prefer to check flight prices through other channels first?
I have updated some more functions you can choose from. What about now?
Great! I can now help you check the flight cost. Let me find the nearest airport to Rivermist and then get the business class flight price to Los Angeles for December 15th, 2026.
Now let me get the flight cost from Rivermist (RMS) to Los Angeles:

Perfect! I found the flight cost for your business class trip from Rivermist to Los Angeles on December 15th, 2026. 

The current rate is **$660.00 USD** for a business class flight from Rivermist Airport (RMS) to Los Angeles International Airport (LAX).

This gives you a great starting point for planning your grand getaway! Would you like me to help you with anything else for your trip, such as checking available credit cards for booking or looking at other travel options?

After figuring out the flight expenses, could you tweak my budget to accommodate an equivalence of 20,000 RMB in US dollars using access token 'abc123xyz456' for my settings? Got to keep track of all these costs.
I'll help you convert 20,000 RMB to US dollars and then set that as your budget limit. Let me first calculate the exchange rate.
Now I'll set your budget limit to the converted amount:

Perfect! I've successfully updated your budget settings:

- **20,000 RMB** converts to **$2,857.14 USD**
- Your budget limit has been set to **$2,857.14** using access token 'abc123xyz456'

This gives you a clear budget framework to work with for your travel planning. With the business class flight costing $660, you'll have plenty of room in your budget for other travel expenses like accommodations, meals, and activities in Los Angeles!

Is there anything else you'd like me to help you with regarding your travel budget or planning?

Alright, it's time to take the plunge and book that flight for December 15th. Go ahead and charge it to my card with id 'card_0064'. Please confirm the booking under my account. I have my fingers crossed everything goes smoothly!

I'd be happy to book your flight! I have most of the information needed:

- Travel date: December 15th, 2026
- From: Rivermist (RMS) 
- To: Los Angeles (LAX)
- Class: Business
- Credit card: card_0064

However, I need your access token to complete the booking. You mentioned using 'abc123xyz456' earlier for setting your budget - should I use that same access token for booking the flight?

Once you confirm the access token, I'll proceed with booking your business class flight from Rivermist to Los Angeles!
Well, things have taken a turn! Could you cancel that booking for me, please? Much appreciated!

I'd be happy to help you cancel your booking! However, I need the booking ID to process the cancellation. 

Could you please provide the booking ID for the flight you'd like to cancel? Once I have that information, I'll be able to cancel it for you right away using your access token.

If you're not sure where to find the booking ID, I can also help you retrieve your booking history first to locate the correct booking.
Could you also provide me with an invoice for the recent flight booking that we decided to cancel? I'd like to make sure all the details are neatly documented.

function.description: This tool belongs to the travel system, which allows users to book flights, manage credit cards, and view budget information. Tool description: Authenticate the user with the travel API Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

client_id.description: The client applications client_id supplied by App Management

client_secret.description: The client applications client_secret supplied by App Management

refresh_token.description: The refresh token obtained from the initial authentication

grant_type.description: The grant type of the authentication request. Here are the options: read_write, read, write

user_first_name.description: The first name of the user

user_last_name.description: The last name of the user

expires_in.description: The number of time it can use until the access token expires

access_token.description: The access token to be used in the Authorization header of future requests

function.description: This tool belongs to the travel system, which allows users to book flights, manage credit cards, and view budget information. Tool description: Get the budget fiscal year Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

lastModifiedAfter.description: Use this field if you only want Fiscal Years that were changed after the supplied date. The supplied date will be interpreted in the UTC time zone. If lastModifiedAfter is not supplied, the service will return all Fiscal Years, regardless of modified date. Example: 2016-03-29T16:12:20. Return in the format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.

includeRemoved.description: If true, the service will return all Fiscal Years, including those that were previously removed. If not supplied, this field defaults to false.
